# JSON-Schema-Test-Suite (vendored)

The draft 2020-12 tests and the remote documents they reference, from
<https://github.com/json-schema-org/JSON-Schema-Test-Suite> at commit
`89e83a74014617ffbe79a56d83d14d054cd11417` (2026-10-21). MIT licence, see
[LICENSE](LICENSE). Copied unchanged; the harness in `src/topics/core_test.j`
runs them, each topic overlay the files for the keywords it owns.

To update: copy `tests/draft2020-12/` and `remotes/` from a newer checkout and
change the commit above.
